reviews.author: chris keeble

reviews.title: Great CPU cooler!
reviews.comment: Excellent, low noise cooler with ARGB fans. Mounting this with to my AMD CPU with the included brackets was easy without removing my motherboard from the case. It fit very well. I did have to mount one of the fans a little higher than normal because of my RGB memory, but it did work out in the end. The color of the fans is decent and works well. It was plug and play with my motherboard's existing ARGB headers. The fan speed is easily controlled with PWM. This has been keeping my CPU much cooler than the Wraith Prism cooler that came with my CPU. Overall an excellent value!
reviews.author: Tony
